glossary.pressures_per_min: Pressure events per minute: how often defenders close down the ball carrier.
glossary.ppda: Passes allowed per defensive action in the opponent's build-up zone. Lower means more aggressive pressing; higher means the team has stopped pressing.
glossary.front_sprints: Sprints (25 km/h or faster for at least one second) by the front-line attackers in the window.
glossary.high_regains: Times the team won the ball back in the opposition's final third in the window.
glossary.progressive_passes: Completed passes that move the ball at least 10 metres toward goal.
glossary.final_third_entries: Times the team moved the ball into the final third by pass or carry.
glossary.xt: Expected threat added: the value gained by moving the ball into more dangerous areas, plus shot quality.

glossary.front_sprints: Sprints (25 km/h or faster for at least one second) by the front-line attackers in the window.
glossary.high_regains: Times the team won the ball back in the opposition's final third in the window.
glossary.progressive_passes: Completed passes that move the ball at least 10 metres toward goal.
glossary.final_third_entries: Times the team moved the ball into the final third by pass or carry.
glossary.xt: Expected threat added: the value gained by moving the ball into more dangerous areas, plus shot quality.
glossary.possession_share: Share of the ball in the window.
glossary.chaos_index: 0-100 score for how chaotic play is: many turnovers and duels, short possessions, long balls. 50 is a typical five minutes of this league; low means orderly control.

explanation.why: Nearest defender in Harbour's half: 6.8 m to 10.7 m. Pressures per minute 0.3 to 0.1, 67% fewer. Harbour's progressive passes per 5 min: 8 to 8.1. But their threat is down (xT 0.09 to 0.04) against the deeper block.
explanation.so_what: Northbridge can't keep the press going, so Harbour now have more time on the ball. Even so, Northbridge's deeper block is limiting the danger.

es.what: El Northbridge ha dejado de presionar
es.why: Defensor más cercano al balón en campo del Harbour: de 6,8 m a 10,7 m. Presiones por minuto de 0,3 a 0,1, un 67% menos. Pases progresivos del Harbour cada 5 min: de 8 a 8,1. Pero su amenaza baja (xT de 0,09 a 0,04) ante el bloque más bajo.
es.so_what: El Northbridge ya no aguanta la presión, así que el Harbour tiene más tiempo con el balón. Aun así, el bloque más bajo del Northbridge limita el peligro.

claims.text: Defensor más cercano al balón en campo del Harbour: de 6,8 m a 10,7 m.
Presiones por minuto de 0,3 a 0,1, un 67% menos.
Pases progresivos del Harbour cada 5 min: de 8 a 8,1.
Pero su amenaza baja (xT de 0,09 a 0,04) ante el bloque más bajo.

caveats: No todos los indicadores coinciden: PPDA, sprints de la línea de ataque, recuperaciones altas, entradas al último tercio, amenaza creada se movieron en sentido contrario.

tr.why: Harbour yarı sahasında topa en yakın savunmacı 6,8 m iken 10,7 m oldu. Dakikadaki baskı sayısı 0,3 iken 0,1 oldu (yüzde 67 düşüş). Harbour ileriye pas sayısı (5 dk) 8 iken 8,1 oldu. Ancak derin blok karşısında tehdit düştü (xT 0,09 iken 0,04 oldu).
tr.so_what: Northbridge baskıyı sürdüremiyor; Harbour artık topla daha rahat oynuyor. Yine de Northbridge geriye çekilerek tehlikeyi sınırlıyor.
